svg.title: Watcher — approved jugular notch study
svg.desc: Organic neck and collarbone ink contours traced from the approved Watcher-jugular-notch-sketch.png (Library libfile_82b6352d9b688191b0da0c799acc7b10, version 0). Source imagery is reference only; this document contains editable cubic Bezier vectors and no embedded raster. Three elliptical resonance rings and rising breath are separately animated by Rust.
